name: Shipment of Iron
summary: In Hillsbrad Fields, raw iron waits at the human smithy, where it arms the townsfolk against the Forsaken.

sections.title: Fueling the Resistance
sections.body:
Human peasants across the Hillsbrad Foothills resist Tarren Mill. Much of their strength comes from the smithy at the southwestern edge of Hillsbrad Fields. Blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices turn heavy shipments of iron into weapons and armor, working round the clock.

Forsaken commanders have ordered the forge put out, its smiths killed, and its stored metal seized for the Horde war effort. They hope to break the farmers’ resolve.

faq.q: Where is the shipment of iron kept?
faq.answer: The iron is kept inside the blacksmith workshop at the southwestern edge of Hillsbrad Fields. Blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices guard it closely.

faq.q: Why does the Forsaken want this iron?
faq.answer: The iron arms the local human militia, and the Forsaken want to cut off that supply. High Executor Darthalia also means to use the stockpiles for the Horde war effort when the offensive turns toward razing Southshore.

faq.q: Who was using this iron originally?
faq.answer: Blacksmith Verringtan and his four apprentice smiths used the iron to arm the townspeople and field workers. They turned simple farmers into a local defense force against the undead.

faq.q: Who orders the retrieval of the iron shipment?
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia commands Forsaken operations out of Tarren Mill. During the Battle of Hillsbrad, she orders the smiths slain and the iron claimed.

angles.text: For a blacksmith, raw iron keeps human arms production in the valley alive. Without the ingots, Verringtan’s forge sits useless.
As a member of the Horde, denying Hillsbrad supplies weakens the farmers’ armed resistance before the campaign moves against Southshore.
